public.definition: Published by the college or the Chancellor's Office, or derived only from what they publish: the catalog, COCI, course outlines of record, program maps and C-ID. Anyone may read it, and COBI may pass it on.

aggregate.definition: Student counts from MAP or the COMIS Data Mart, published only as counts and suppressed below the minimum cell size. The rule is the student-detail disclosure ADR (docs/kb-notes/adr-student-detail-aggregate-disclosure-control.md): a cell backed by fewer than 10 distinct students is suppressed, at write time, with complementary suppression wherever a total is published. Two older surfaces keep their own floors: the CER's public student counts mask below 5 (adr-cer-student-impact-counts-privacy), and the funding counts mask below 10 (adr-funding-priority-metrics-privacy).

agreement.definition: Held or passed on only under a data-sharing agreement or the holder's written permission. COBI shows its status and, where one exists, an aggregate; never the record itself.

held.definition: COBI or MAP holds it for the team's own work. It is never published and is left out of any outside share by default.

join_keys.name: Program control number
join_keys.definition: COCI's number for an approved program. It joins the public program record (catalog, COCI, program maps) to program awards reported to COMIS.
join_keys.public_side: The program's catalog record, its COCI record and its program map
join_keys.other_side: Program awards in COMIS, counted by control number
join_keys.comis_note: The issue names SP04; the repo's own reference files do not record the SP element ids, so the id is left empty.

join_keys.name: Award type
join_keys.definition: The kind of award a program leads to (an associate degree, a certificate and so on). It sorts program awards on both sides of the control-number join.
join_keys.comis_note: The issue names SP02; the repo's own reference files do not record the SP element ids, so the id is left empty.

join_keys.name: Course control number
join_keys.definition: COCI's number for an approved course. It joins the public course record (catalog, COCI, the outline) to the course basic record in COMIS.
join_keys.public_side: The course's catalog entry, its COCI record and its outline of record
join_keys.comis_note: The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the element number is not in the repo.

join_keys.name: TOP code
join_keys.definition: The Taxonomy of Programs code a college assigns to a course or program. Faculty-entered and unreliable, so COBI uses it to corroborate or filter, never to decide identity.
join_keys.public_side: The course's and the program's COCI record
join_keys.comis_note: The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the element number is not in the repo.

join_keys.name: MIS college code
join_keys.definition: The three-character code COMIS uses for a college (Appendix A of the MIS Data Element Dictionary). It joins CDC's college to every COMIS file and Data Mart figure.
join_keys.other_side: COMIS files and the Data Mart's aggregates
join_keys.comis_note: The column name in kb/reference/cb_course_basic_fall2025.csv; the codes are in kb/reference/mis_district_college_codes.json.

join_keys.name: Course and college
join_keys.definition: A college's local course, named by the college and its course. It joins a CPL articulation in MAP to the aggregate CPL counts for that course.
join_keys.public_side: The college's course in its catalog and COCI
join_keys.other_side: MAP's CPL articulations and the aggregate CPL counts

join_keys.name: C-ID number
join_keys.definition: The C-ID descriptor a course is approved against. It joins a college's course to the common descriptor and to MAP's articulation rows, which carry the same number.
